integrity: The proof reaches the full published factor-complexity count at every factor length needed for orders one through six, making the finite lists exhaustive. The packaged checker reconstructs the prefix by two equivalent constructions and recomputes every block-sum test from the embedded source.
scientific_limitations: The result gives only the minimum order and complete equality layer at that order for additive fourth powers in the Tribonacci word. It does not characterize larger orders or arbitrary additive k-powers. Exhaustiveness of the finite factor lists uses the published factor-complexity identity p(m)=2m+1.
title: The first additive fourth power in the Tribonacci word has order six
